answer: A farm must as a result either lie, which the sparrow graph proves on replay, or recruit 200 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the marble registry records each claim and the willow audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 50% of the attester's bond. That is 9 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
